title: Texas Tech University Health Scienes Center El Paso (TTU)

sections.heading: What TTU is known for
paragraphs: Texas Tech University Health Sciences Center El Paso (TTU) is a public institution primarily recognized for its focus on health-related programs. The university's undergraduate enrollment stands at 242 students, reflecting its specialized academic environment. TTU dedicates its entire program share to health disciplines, emphasizing its commitment to training healthcare professionals. Unlike some universities, TTU does not offer business programs, highlighting its concentrated expertise in the health sciences. As a public university, TTU serves the community by providing education and research opportunities in the medical and health fields.

sections.heading: Diversity
paragraphs: Texas Tech University Health Sciences Center El Paso (TTU) demonstrates a highly diverse student body, with Hispanic students comprising approximately 88.43% of the undergraduate population. Women represent the majority of students at TTU, accounting for about 83.47%, while men make up roughly 16.53%. The university enrolls a smaller proportion of White students, around 2.89%, and Black students constitute about 1.24%. Asian students represent approximately 0.41% of the student body. Additionally, over half of the students, 52.97%, receive Pell Grants, indicating a significant portion of the student population benefits from federal financial aid aimed at supporting those with financial need.
